title: Towards Equity in Skin Cancer: An analysis of melanoma cohorts
summary: This retrospective, inter-institutional analysis of melanoma patients from LMU Munich and Stellenbosch University compares clinical presentation, stage at diagnosis, care pathways, and disease-related outcomes between the two cohorts.

interventions.name: Melanompatients of  Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München and Stellenbosch University (recording period  1.1.2010 - 31.12.2025)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Availability of complete datasets for patients with acral lentiginous melanoma
Exclusion criteria:
complete datasets
